title: Home-canning botulism warning signs
summary: Reject unsafe jars without tasting; botulinum toxin may have no visible, smelled or tasted warning.
steps: Do not taste food from a jar with unknown recipe, process, pressure, time, seal or storage history.
Treat a leaking, bulging, cracked, spurting, foaming, mouldy or abnormally odorous jar as unsafe.
Keep people and animals away while following official disposal instructions that avoid splashing or skin contact.
If anyone develops possible botulism symptoms after preserved food, seek emergency medical help immediately and report the food history.
Prevent recurrence by using only current tested recipes and the correct canning equipment.
